questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] Which part of the human body is affected by hepatitis?
A. Heart B. Liver C. Lungs
Answer: B. Hepatitis can be caused by viruses, alcohol use, toxins, certain medications, and some other medical conditions.
questions.de: Welches Organ des menschlichen Körpers ist bei einer Hepatitis entzündet?
questions.en: Which organ of the human body is inflamed in hepatitis?

timeline.labelEn: Hippocrates records the first documented epidemic of jaundice, linked to the liver
timeline.labelDe: Hippokrates dokumentiert die erste bekannte Gelbsucht-Epidemie, die er mit der Leber in Verbindung bringt

questions.cardText:
[Art History] Why does the Mona Lisa have no eyebrows?
A. They were not fashionable during the Renaissance
B. Because it was an unfinished painting
C. There were eyebrows, but they faded
Answer: C. Recent analysis reveals that the Mona Lisa originally had eyebrows. However, restoration efforts, cleaning, and the passage of time have contributed to the gradual fading and removal of both the eyebrows and eyelashes.
questions.de: Was geschah laut den ultrahochauflösenden Scans von Pascal Cotte aus dem Jahr 2007 mit den Augenbrauen und Wimpern der Mona Lisa, die auf dem Gemälde heute nicht mehr deutlich zu sehen sind?
questions.en: According to Pascal Cotte's 2007 ultra-high-resolution scans, what happened to the Mona Lisa's eyebrows and eyelashes, which the painting no longer clearly shows?
questions.answerDe: Sie waren gemalt, verblassten aber im Lauf der Zeit
questions.answerEn: They were painted but faded away over time

timeline.labelEn: Pascal Cotte announces scans suggesting the Mona Lisa was painted with eyebrows and eyelashes that later disappeared
timeline.labelDe: Pascal Cotte stellt Scans vor, nach denen die Mona Lisa mit Augenbrauen und Wimpern gemalt wurde, die später verschwanden

questions.notes: One researcher's finding (perhaps lost through overcleaning), not settled fact; Vasari (1568) described the eyebrows in detail. Accept 'they faded / were cleaned away'.
